d: Dilip Jaiswal Statement : purniya men ‘loktantr bachao, arajakta hatao’ abhiyan ke dauran BJP neta dilip jayasval ne rahul gandhi aur tejasvi yadav ko lekar bara bayan diya. unhonne aarop lagaya ki rahul gandhi vipaksh ke dusre netaon ko aage nahin barhne dena chahte. bihar men SIR yatra ka jikr karte hue unhonne dava kiya ki tejasvi yadav ko chauthe nanbar par rakha gaya tha aur rahul gandhi ne unhen aage aane se roka tha. tejasvi yadav ke ramlila maidan men vot chori ke aaropon par bhi dilip jayasval ne rahul gandhi aur vipakshi gathbandhan par nishana sadha. dekhie unka pura bayana.
